login.title: Channel Partner Partner Login
login.welcome: Siyakwamkela emva! Sayina ukuze ulawule iinkokeli zakho.
login.heroTitle: Khulisa ishishini lakho lezindlu nomhlaba ngalo lonke ukhokelo oza nalo
login.heroIntro: I-portal enye yokubhalisa abathengi kunye nabakhi, gcina ikhredithi yesikhokelo sakho kwaye ulandele ukubhukisha.

register.title: Bhalisa kukhokelela kwimizuzwana
register.text: Ngenisa umthengi wakho kunye neprojekthi abanomdla kuyo.

protect.title: Ukukhuselwa okuphindwe kabini
protect.text: Isikhokelo sakho sihlala sesakho ixesha lokhuseleko, ke kungabikho mntu wumbi onokubanga umthengi ofanayo.

track.title: Landela inqanaba ngalinye
track.text: Bona ubume bomkhokheli ngamnye kunye nembali epheleleyo, ukusuka kunxibelelwano lokuqala ukuya kubhukisho.

handover.title: Ityala xa ubhukisha
handover.text: Xa iincwadi zabathengi, ukhokelo lunikezelwa kumakhi kunye nawe urekhodwe njengeqabane lomthombo.

login.secure: Ukungena ngokukhuselekileyo - iinkcukacha zabathengi bakho zihlala ziyimfihlo

signup.title: UBhaliso lomlingane weChaneli
signup.intro: Yenza iakhawunti yakho ukuqala ukubhalisa kunye nokulawula izikhokelo zakho.
